exercises.title: Waterfall vs agile 1 — which approach?
exercises.problemHtml:
Waterfall: a linear sequence — fully specify requirements, then design, code and test. Agile: iterative and incremental development in short iterations (sprints of one week to a month), each adding a small set of functionality, tested and validated against acceptance criteria, with ongoing customer participation. Which approach does each statement describe?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Waterfall: tuần tự — đặc tả đủ yêu cầu rồi thiết kế, code, test. Agile: lặp và tăng dần theo vòng ngắn, mỗi vòng thêm một ít chức năng, có khách tham gia liên tục.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Waterfall vs agile 2 — why the waterfall struggles
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers: large waterfall projects are often delivered late, lack needed features and miss expectations, because of the layers of dependency built on the requirements, and because stakeholders will change requirements — they do not know precisely what they want at the start.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Waterfall vs agile 2 — why the waterfall struggles — answer key

1. The main advantage claimed for the waterfall is…Ưu điểm chính được nêu của waterfall là…
   Answer: a) catching flaws early, when fixing is cheaper
   Early, complete requirements in theory reduce later rework.VI: Về lý thuyết, yêu cầu đầy đủ sớm giảm làm lại.

2. Why does feedback come late in a waterfall project?Vì sao phản hồi đến muộn trong waterfall?
   Answer: a) Customers see working software only near the end
   So requirement errors surface at their most expensive.VI: Nên lỗi yêu cầu lộ ra lúc đắt nhất.

3. Agile fits best when…Agile hợp nhất khi…
   Answer: a) requirements are uncertain or expected to evolve and customers can be continuously available
   Uncertainty + available customers + value from early delivery.VI: Bất định + khách luôn sẵn + giá trị từ giao sớm.

exercises.title: Waterfall vs agile 3 — choose an approach for the project
exercises.problemHtml:
Choose the more suitable approach for each project: more predictive (waterfall-like), or adaptive (agile). Think about how stable the requirements are, how available the customer is, and the value of early delivery.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Chọn cách tiếp cận phù hợp hơn: dự đoán (kiểu waterfall) hay thích ứng (agile).

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

   Stable, regulated, contract-fixed requirements with little customer availability favour a predictive approach; evolving needs with an engaged product owner favour agile. Many real projects are hybrids.

o.s: A start-up app; the founders keep learning what users want from weekly feedback.
Replacing a payroll module whose rules are fixed by law, with a fixed-price contract and a customer available only at milestones.
A new student portal; the product owner sits with the team every day and wants features released early.
Firmware for a certified medical pump with strict, stable regulatory requirements.

bang.giaiThich: Stable, regulated, contract-fixed requirements with little customer availability favour a predictive approach; evolving needs with an engaged product owner favour agile. Many real projects are hybrids.
